title: Sovereign AI Control Plane Backlog
invariants: Starlight creates the trace_id before provider dispatch.
Secret records never leave local authority.
Regulated records require an explicit external-mirror policy.
A provider trace ID is a shadow reference, not the canonical receipt.
Provider failure cannot prevent the local trace receipt.
Production feedback becomes a candidate evaluation case, never automatic truth.
No per-terminal heavyweight collector, index, or memory runtime.

work_items.title: Define the provider-neutral SISAITraceEnvelope contract
work_items.why: Provides one immutable correlation and policy shape across direct providers, optional gateways, agent runs, tool calls, and evaluations.
dependencies: Clean dedicated worktree based on the intended starlight-memory commit
acceptance: Types compile.
Tests first prove parent-child spans, unknown cost, privacy classes, prompt references, and provider shadow references.
No runtime dependency is added.
work_items.risk: Do not let a generic trace schema become a second policy system; reference existing SIS privacy and provenance types.

work_items.title: Write durable local trace receipts with bounded indexing
work_items.why: Closes the core observability gap while retaining local sovereignty and operation during vendor outage.
acceptance: Write succeeds before optional provider export.
Trace lookup by trace_id works after process restart.
Disk and retention behavior is explicit and bounded.
Provider dispatch failure still creates a failed trace receipt.
work_items.risk: No new per-agent daemon or unbounded local payload retention.

work_items.title: Add policy-aware trace export decisions
work_items.why: Makes OpenTelemetry and optional vendor export safe without treating the vendor as canonical.
acceptance: Secret traces are local-only.
Regulated traces default local-only.
Redacted export has a provenance receipt.
Export is skipped, not retried blindly, when policy denies it.
work_items.risk: Input/output payloads must not leak under metadata or error fields.

work_items.title: Create trace-to-evaluation candidate selection
work_items.why: Turns production failures and corrections into measurable regression cases rather than dashboard noise.
acceptance: Feedback, policy blocks, and configured failures create de-duplicated candidate cases.
Candidate has trace and prompt provenance.
Candidate promotion requires independent evaluation evidence.
work_items.risk: Never turn raw customer data into a fixture without a privacy review.

work_items.title: Implement a policy-aware provider gateway adapter
work_items.why: Provides controlled retries, fallbacks, capability routing, and cost/latency receipts without an external gateway becoming mandatory.
acceptance: At least two direct provider adapters share one trace and policy contract.
Fallback is policy-gated and recorded before dispatch.
Optional Orq/OpenTelemetry export is an adapter, not a required path.
work_items.risk: Do not duplicate subscription-capacity planning in request-time routing.

work_items.title: Ship a privacy-safe local operational view
work_items.why: Brings together trace health, blocked actions, evaluation backlog, and capacity without exposing raw private prompts.
acceptance: Shows receipt freshness, outcome state, latency/cost aggregates, policy blocks, and evaluation candidate counts.
Does not render secret payloads.
References canonical artifacts rather than copying their data.
work_items.risk: Do not build a visual dashboard before the receipt contract works.

work_items.title: Enterprise tenancy and vendor adapters
work_items.why: Adds RBAC, SSO/SCIM, quotas, private deployment, and approved enterprise integrations only if a customer needs them.
acceptance: Tenant isolation and audit export are tested.
Vendor exit/export path is exercised.
Commercial margin and operational burden are approved.
work_items.risk: Do not acquire enterprise platform complexity for hypothetical demand.
